title: The policy gradient theorem, exactly and by REINFORCE
brief: Compute the exact gradient of a softmax policy's return on a small MDP, confirm it with finite differences, then show that REINFORCE estimates the same vector without bias.
hints: The score of a softmax is one-hot minus probabilities: row s of grad log pi(a | s) is e_a - pi[s], and every other row is zero.
rlenvs.state_distribution returns the visitation normalised to sum to one. With no terminal states, divide it by (1 - gamma) to get d(s) = sum_t gamma^t Pr(s_t = s).
The advantage table is rlenvs.q_from_v(mdp, v) - v[:, None].
REINFORCE weights step t by gamma^t * G_t, not by G_t alone. Dropping gamma^t changes the expectation, and the last check detects it.
np.add.at(grad, states, weights[:, None] * scores) adds each step's scaled score into its state's row, even when a state repeats.
